integrity: The proof uses explicit polynomial generator identities and invariant-measure averaging. A symbolic checker verifies the pointwise algebra. Literature comparisons distinguish the new stationary law from prior ultimate-bound, synchronization, and Hopf results.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures of the printed autonomous complex Chen vector field. It does not classify all noncompact or transient trajectories, and it does not independently establish existence of a chaotic attractor in any parameter regime.
title: Exact stationary balances and a recurrence-exclusion plane in the complex Chen system
